title: Probabilistic Plan Legibility with Off-the-shelf Planners
abstract: arXiv:2610.00065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Legible planning is the creation of plans that best disambiguate their goals from a set of other candidates from an observer's perspective. In this paper we propose a method for legible planning for arbitrary PDDL domains, by extending previous research on legibility to classical planning without requiring to construct ad-hoc planners. We also discuss how the observer perspective may be estimated through a second order theory of mind that connects the planner's and the observer's task spaces. Our solution can for example be deployed in human-robot teaming scenarios, where an autonomous robot in a team can implicitly communicate its goal by producing legible plans. We present benchmark results on several PDDL planning domains. Our results generally show that plan legibility is a trade-off with plan efficiency, however, not all planning domains allows to increase legibility in the same way and a regularizing factor to balance legibility

translated_title: 基于现成规划器的概率化计划易读性
translated_abstract: 易读规划是指从观察者的视角出发，创建能够最好地将其目标从一组候选目标中区分出来的计划。在本文中，我们提出了一种面向任意PDDL领域的易读规划方法，通过将先前关于易读性的研究扩展到经典规划中，而无需构建专门定制的规划器。我们还讨论了如何通过一种二阶心智理论来估计观察者的视角，该理论将规划者与观察者的任务空间联系起来。例如，我们的解决方案可以部署在人机协作场景中，团队中的自主机器人可以通过生成易读的计划来隐式地传达其目标。我们在多个PDDL规划领域上展示了基准测试结果。我们的结果总体上表明，计划易读性与计划效率之间存在权衡，然而，并非所有规划领域都能以相同的方式提高易读性，并且需要一个正则化因子来平衡易读性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于现成规划器、适用于任意PDDL领域的易读规划方法，无需构建定制规划器，并通过二阶心智理论估计观察者视角，使机器人能够通过易读计划隐式传达其目标，同时揭示了易读性与规划效率之间的权衡关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a legible planning method for arbitrary PDDL domains using off-the-shelf planners without constructing ad-hoc planners, leveraging a second-order theory of mind to estimate the observer's perspective, enabling robots to implicitly communicate their goals through legible plans while revealing the trade-off between legibility and plan efficiency.
